Make sure to wishlist our game and try our demo out now! Your feedback will be essential as we continue to perfect our recipe for the full game! Japan is beautiful this time of year Create life again in a worn out, forgotten alley. Explore your surroundings and wander through cozy, lantern-lit backstreets and find inspiration for the task ahead. Maybe visit your local convini and look for exiting new ingredients or that unique decoration. You never know where an old recipe might be laying around. Decorate for days Roll up your sleeves, fix up equipment in your kitchen and paint all your old walls. Complete challenges and unlock a wide array of unique decorations, customizations and recipes. Whether you prefer a quirky, bustling diner with mismatched charm or an elegant, fine dining establishment that oozes sophistication, the choice is yours. Don’t forget to check out the gacha machine to have a chance to pull that special item! Clean your way to the top Clean, paint, and cook your way to the top. Hard workers have the best equipment and can afford the best ingredients. Or maybe you want to splash all the cash on 50 darumas? Just make sure to be on top of cleaning - no one enjoys a shop with dirty floors and a full trash can, your customers will notice! Sweep the floor, make sure that all your lights work and keep an eye on the toilet to maintain a clean shop. Everything starts with a good bowl The most important thing in a ramen restaurant is a really good bowl. Prepare all the ingredients, your amazing broth and have the best protein in town. Unlock receipts to extend you menu and earn more cash to level up your ingredient-game! Handle your menu on your restaurants kenbaiki and attract different type of customers, do basic ramen bowls really good or dive in to different types, just make sure your up to serve your customers what they ordered. Let us cook We are still working hard on this experience, so please join our discord and follow our social medias! We want to hear what you think and discuss everything from features to gameplay, let’s cook up something great!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Excited to try your hand at running a ramen shop?

We're serving a taste of the experience with our playable demo. Head over to our demo page and try it out right now!

Make sure to wishlist our game and try our demo out now! Your feedback will be essential as we continue to perfect our recipe for the full game!

Japan is beautiful this time of year

Create life again in a worn out, forgotten alley. Explore your surroundings and wander through cozy, lantern-lit backstreets and find inspiration for the task ahead. Maybe visit your local convini and look for exiting new ingredients or that unique decoration. You never know where an old recipe might be laying around.

Decorate for days

Roll up your sleeves, fix up equipment in your kitchen and paint all your old walls. Complete challenges and unlock a wide array of unique decorations, customizations and recipes. Whether you prefer a quirky, bustling diner with mismatched charm or an elegant, fine dining establishment that oozes sophistication, the choice is yours. Don’t forget to check out the gacha machine to have a chance to pull that special item!

Clean your way to the top

Clean, paint, and cook your way to the top. Hard workers have the best equipment and can afford the best ingredients. Or maybe you want to splash all the cash on 50 darumas? Just make sure to be on top of cleaning - no one enjoys a shop with dirty floors and a full trash can, your customers will notice! Sweep the floor, make sure that all your lights work and keep an eye on the toilet to maintain a clean shop. 

Everything starts with a good bowl

The most important thing in a ramen restaurant is a really good bowl. Prepare all the ingredients, your amazing broth and have the best protein in town. Unlock receipts to extend you menu and earn more cash to level up your ingredient-game! Handle your menu on your restaurants kenbaiki and attract different type of customers, do basic ramen bowls really good or dive in to different types, just make sure your up to serve your customers what they ordered. 

Let us cook

We are still working hard on this experience, so please join our discord and follow our social medias! We want to hear what you think and discuss everything from features to gameplay, let’s cook up something great!
